title: Successor identity for signed integer encoding
statement: Let $e$ be an integer, and define $a(e)$ by $a(e)=-e-1$ when $e<0$ and $a(e)=e$ when $e\geq 0$. Then $a(e)+1$ equals $|e|$ when $e<0$, and equals $|e|+1$ when $e\geq 0$.
